The Apple Music Provider is built in; enable the recommended LSPosed scopes.\n\nFor other apps, open Lyricon Config and add the official Provider. HyperLyrics Enhanced includes Lyricon Central compatibility in SystemUI, so no separate lyrics service is needed. Restart the music app and SystemUI after adding or updating a Provider.
